# BorderCover Atlas

> An independent, source-backed research tool for driving your own car abroad. It does not sell, quote or bind insurance. Personal policy confirmation remains essential.

Public crawling is disallowed until qualified legal review. robots.txt uses `Disallow: /` for every user agent, and HTML pages send `noindex`.

## Key pages

- [Checker](https://bordercover.shop/): Compare published overseas motor cover, trip allowances, transit-country conditions and original evidence. Personal policy confirmation remains essential.
- [Atlas](https://bordercover.shop/atlas): Published policy terms and unresolved conditions, country by country.
- [Insurer pages](https://bordercover.shop/cover): Tier-by-tier research pages for named insurers and driving destinations.
- [Guides](https://bordercover.shop/guides): Plain-English guides to Green Cards, Mexican liability, Ireland–UK driving and more.
- [Methodology](https://bordercover.shop/methodology): How published wording is compared, and what a result does not confirm.
- [Evidence register](https://bordercover.shop/sources): Original documents, observed quotations and separately approved editorial evidence.
- [Change log](https://bordercover.shop/change-log): Dated record of research dataset updates.
- [Privacy](https://bordercover.shop/privacy): How trip selections, fragment links, correction reports and reviewer accounts are handled.
- [Terms](https://bordercover.shop/terms): Limitations of the research and the need to confirm a personal policy.

## Guides

- [Driving an Australian car in New Zealand](https://bordercover.shop/guides/australia-car-insurance-in-new-zealand): What RACV says about cover outside Australia when taking your own car to New Zealand, and what to confirm before shipping.
- [Irish car insurance in the UK](https://bordercover.shop/guides/ie-car-insurance-in-uk): Understand car insurance from Ireland to Great Britain or Northern Ireland: home territorial cover, Green Cards and documentation.
- [Irish car insurance in France](https://bordercover.shop/guides/irish-car-insurance-in-france): Aviva Ireland, Allianz Ireland and 123.ie foreign-use cover in France: 31, 60 and 30-day conditions compared.
- [An NZ-insured car in Australia](https://bordercover.shop/guides/new-zealand-car-insurance-in-australia): Review AMI motor-policy exclusions for driving a New Zealand-registered car in Australia and the separate cover to arrange.
- [Does UK insurance cover France?](https://bordercover.shop/guides/uk-car-insurance-in-france): Understand UK car insurance in France: legal third-party cover, insurer day limits, Green Cards and what to take on a road trip.
- [UK car insurance in Ireland](https://bordercover.shop/guides/uk-car-insurance-in-ireland): UK-to-Ireland motor insurance: UK third-party minimum, AA and LV Ireland exceptions, and whether a Green Card is needed.
- [The Green Card decision guide](https://bordercover.shop/guides/uk-green-card-rules): Which European destinations are Green Card-free for UK drivers, and where you may need proof or border insurance.
- [US car insurance in Canada](https://bordercover.shop/guides/us-car-insurance-in-canada): Check Progressive, GEICO and USAA insurance when driving your own US-insured car into Canada. Cover levels, proof and limitations.
- [US car insurance in Mexico](https://bordercover.shop/guides/us-car-insurance-in-mexico): Find out why regular US car insurance usually does not meet Mexican liability requirements, and what coverage to buy before driving south.

## Limits

Coverage statements describe published insurer and government documents. They are not a quotation, a certificate of insurance, or legal advice. Insurer-country URLs stay out of the sitemap until every plan on the page passes claim-level indexing eligibility. The private editorial workspace is not listed.
